title: VIRA (Vigilance And Rapid Alerts)
technologies: RL, Gymnasium, Isaac Sim, Pytorch, FaceNet
description: Built an AI-powered surveillance platform integrating autonomous drones and CCTV networks for real-time monitoring, facial recognition, crowd analysis, and anomaly detection across large geographic areas. Developed a real-time alert and response pipeline with incident geolocation, safe hover-zone calculation, and autonomous drone dispatch for rapid threat verification. Engineered scalable cloud infrastructure with real-time GPS tracking of multiple drones and zone-based surveillance management across different regions.

title: Nihongono-Practice
description: Nihongo is a Japanese-learning website designed to help beginners prepare for the JLPT N5 level. It provides structured learning resources such as Hiragana, Katakana, vocabulary, grammar, quizzes, and practice exercises, making it easier to learn Japanese step by step through an interactive web interface.

title: Pure Change
description: PureChange was designed and built through deep product discussion, behavioral logic planning, security design, and iterative engineering. PureChange is a motivation and consistency workspace that functions like a structured streak and progression system, helping users shift away from destructive habits and move toward disciplined routines involving yoga, meditation, fitness, and daily structure.

title: Medilog
description: Hospital management application with Google OAuth-based authentication and role-specific access for doctors, patients, and staff, supporting appointment booking, record management, and real-time video consultations.
